An omitted indicator alone cannot repair false finite DP distribution

withdrawn_findings.title: Printed gamma conditional omits beta_K factor
withdrawn_findings.reason: False source reading: actual physical PDF page 19 Algorithm 1 step 8 has product upper limit K, not K-1. No omission is present. The frozen source and rendered page are unchanged.

P1.source_conditions: Original C.26-C.29 physical pp.14-15: T>=K finite symmetric Dirichlet weights, iid product-space atoms independent of weights. Inspected equation pixels; no missing hidden indicator in C.28.
P1.decisive_check: Whole-space C.28 RHS=K whereas LHS=1. After inserting selection indicator, finite weights give E sum pi_t^2=(1+alpha/T)/(1+alpha). For T=K=2, alpha=1, local set probability 1/2, variance=3/16; DP marginal variance=1/8. Independent mixture second moment=1/4+(1/2)(3/8)=7/16. Uniform bases on Polish [0,1] and proper normal kernels meet the generic construction.
P1.counterevidence_and_impact: The extra factor tends to one; neither limit theorem nor infinite construction is refuted. C.29 explicitly states a finite DP law and is used to infer the limiting model, so Major for invalid core derivation remains supported. Correcting the missing indicator alone is insufficient; a replacement joint convergence proof remains uncertified.

P2.source_conditions: Physical pp.15-17 distinguish lumped-tail stick-breaking truncation from C's finite Dirichlet approximation; labels are shared per local table and the global weights are shared across groups.
P2.decisive_check: J=1,n=2,T=K=2,alpha=gamma=1 gives P(good)=E[u^2]E[v]=1/6 rather than E[u^2]E[v^2]=1/9. Conditional on local assignments, M<=N distinct tables require labels and S^M>=S^N; independence of local/global sticks and Jensen yield the displayed lower bound for P(good), preserving the required TV upper inequality. Posterior averaged L1 follows by triangle inequality with the same fixed-concentration assumptions.
P2.severity_repair: Minor local equality, because the needed inequality in that very proof direction is valid without changing hypotheses or rate; classification is not based on ease of repair. The report now states that basis explicitly. No hyperprior-mean substitution or false-theorem claim is endorsed.

withdrawn_former_P3.source_check: Actual physical PDF p.19 image shows product upper limit K in Algorithm 1 step 8. This includes beta_K. The initial K-1 reading is false.
withdrawn_former_P3.correction: Removed the unsupported Problem and gamma-ratio evidence attribution, replaced with no-omission check, renumbered former P4/P5 to P3/P4, synchronized existing script/results and report. Earlier files preserved. Correct algebra and static full-vector sum agree.

P3.source_conditions: Physical p.21 step3 includes s1/s2 in second Beta parameter. Static VI_functions.cpp:146-186 receives but does not use b_bar; reverse_cumsum returns only later counts, and R passes the positive current mean.
P3.decisive_check: For nonfinal first stick at T=2, xi=(1/2,1/2), Ealpha=1: release Beta(3/2,1/2), correct Beta(3/2,3/2). Means 3/4 versus 1/2 and analytical KL=1 nat; independently checked reviewer scalar script reproduces them. Final-stick convention cannot explain a first-stick discrepancy.
P3.severity_repair: Minor release-specific mismatch. Printed CAVI coordinate survives; no historical-score link. Adding Ealpha restores only this coordinate, with whole algorithm/performance untested.

P4.source_conditions: Inspected ELBO_functions.cpp:62-68,539-596 and GLocalVI.R:204-208,256-267: Wishart helper is entropy; Normal-Wishart helper returns Elogq and caller adds it.
P4.decisive_check: For p=1, Wishart(2,1/2)=Gamma(1,1), ElogLambda=-EulerGamma, entropy=1. Elogq=0.5 ElogLambda+0.5(log(lambda/(2pi))-1)-1. Lambda multiplier 1 to exp(2) adds one to Elogq, while entropy must decrease one. Corrected reviewer-only scalar script returns -2.707546 and -1.707546. This is parameter-dependent, excluding a constant-offset defense.
P4.severity_repair: Minor release objective error used in stopping/restart selection; no observed winner change or historical paper effect. Negating these two terms repairs only these contributions. Beta normalizer alternatives are correctly negative log B and are not extra findings.
